  RootPackage
  public fun notComparable(): NotComparable
    =
      Call NotComparable
        Call Reference
SourceFile
  RootPackage
  public struct Leaf
  public struct Pair
    field first: Leaf
    field second: Leaf
  public enum Choice
    Empty
    Full(Pair)
  public struct Manual
    public operator fun equals
  public struct UsesManual
    field value: Manual
  public struct Overloaded
    public operator fun equals
  public class Reference()
  public struct NotComparable
    field value: Reference
  public fun sameChoice(left: Choice, right: Choice): Boolean
    =
      Binary Eq
        Var left
        Var right
  public fun sameManual(left: UsesManual, right: UsesManual): Boolean
    =
      Binary Eq
        Var left
        Var right
  public fun sameOverloaded(left: Overloaded, right: Overloaded): Boolean
    =
      Binary Eq
        Var left
        Var right
